FPG links the macroeconomic dialogue with programs focused on expanding the role of the private sector in economic development. In its day-to-day engagement, FPG supports Ministries of Finance, Planning, Economy, Industry and Trade, and Production in pursuing reform agendas that strengthen job creation through inclusive, private sector-led growth. For more information: https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/topic/fiscal-policy-and-growth Background and general description The FPG unit for Southern Africa and East Africa (EAEM2) is looking for a local economist to be based in Maputo, Mozambique. The selected candidate will contribute substantially to analytical work and lending operations. She or he will report to the FPG Practice Manager covering the EAEM2 unit, which comprises 14 countries across three Country Management Units: AECS1 (South Africa, Botswana, Eswatini, Lesotho, Namibia), AECS2 (Mozambique, Comoros, Madagascar, Mauritius, Seychelles), and AECC2 (Angola, Democratic Republic of Congo, São Tomé and Príncipe, and Burundi).
